narrative.overview: Native Android shooting controls around an accurately framed live preview. Configuration and diagnostics live in Settings and Developer mode.

rules.name: Keep footage visible
rules.body: Preserve fitted preview framing and move shooting controls beside it in landscape.

dos: Use native Android controls and system text.
Keep originals and explain separate effect export.
donts: Do not stretch footage to fill the screen.
Do not replace recording state with color alone.
